lines.zh: 我贴着沙面滑，像一片会动的沙子。
lines.en: I glide over the sand, a moving patch of it.

lines.zh: 身子一抖，沙子从背上落下。
lines.en: A shake and the sand slides off my back.
I sway my tail slowly in the warm water.
My colour matches the seabed exactly.

lines.zh: 我浮到半格高，又沉下去。
lines.en: I lift half a block, then settle.
Fine streams of sand run off my fins.
I circle a clump of coral.
My path curves like a wave.
I come up to the shallows, then go back.

lines.zh: 有一层薄沙盖在我头上。
lines.en: A thin layer of sand sits on my head.
I swim with the warm current.

lines.zh: 我的嘴在沙里吸了一下。
lines.en: My mouth draws on the sand.

lines.zh: 我把身子的颜色调暗了。
lines.en: I darken my own colour.

lines.zh: 我摆尾转身，几乎没有痕迹。
lines.en: A flick of the tail turns me, barely a trace.
I stop at the base of the coral.

lines.zh: 沙从我身上滑下来，像雨。
lines.en: Sand slides off me like rain.
I've half buried myself.
My eyes turn above the sand.

lines.zh: 一只小虾从我面前跑过。
lines.en: A small shrimp runs past my face.
My fins fan gently.
The sand on my back levels out.
I'm waiting for the water to warm.

lines.zh: 珊瑚的影子落在我身上。
lines.en: Coral shadows fall on me.
I release a small string of bubbles.
I'm perfectly still, like a stone.
Ripples bend around me.
I lift myself to look.
It's cool under the sand.
I make a very slow turn.
Another layer of sand settles on me.

lines.zh: 你踩下去的地方，就是我。
lines.en: Where you're stepping is me.

lines.zh: 我在你的脚边，你还没发现。
lines.en: I'm by your foot, unnoticed.
I lift my head out of the sand.
Your boots are too heavy.
Don't dig with your hands.
My colour is shifting.
It took you three looks.
I swim half a block toward you.

lines.zh: 你的影子和我的沙很配。
lines.en: Your shadow goes with my sand.
I want to get back in the water.
I jerk up out of the sand.
My sand pattern breaks up.
I swim off a short way.
There's a scratch on my scales.
The water reddens; that's my blood.
I sink back onto the sand.
I beat my tail and throw up sand.
I stop and steady myself.
A patch of my sand colour fades.
I haven't gone far.
That smells of sea worms.
Put it on the sand.
I rise slowly.
I can bite through this.

lines.zh: 这味道让我从沙里探头。
lines.en: That smell brings my head out of the sand.
The sand will cover it.
I barely stir the sand coming near.
Very fresh.
I lift my head and open my mouth.
A little lower.
You stepped on my back.
I dive straight into the sand.
A puff of sand on your foot.
I pull away and show my head again.
You nearly tripped.
The sand moved with me.
The contact was soft.
My tail scatters the ripples.
You caught your balance, so I stopped.
Give me room; I want the water.

lines.zh: 另一条沙色的影子在动。
lines.en: Another sand-coloured shape moves.
We circle the same coral.
Her sand shade is paler.
We press together; our sand mixes.
She swims first; I follow.
We skim the seabed side by side.
Her fin touches mine.

lines.zh: 暖流把我们推向同一处。
lines.en: The warm current pushes us the same way.
We both stop beneath the coral.
She leaves; I stay a while.
I take a piece of coral.
I pick up what the sand hides.
It's slick as water.
I hold it under my fin.
This colour is bright.
It smells of shell.
I swallow it.
Too heavy; I let go.
It rolls into a coral crevice.
I'll keep it for later.
Something's moving ahead.
I rise from the sand.
I swim once in that direction.

lines.zh: 我把自己从沙里拔出来。
lines.en: I pull myself out of the sand.
It hasn't noticed me.
My sand colour hides me well.
I've measured the gap.
The current brings its smell.
I press myself to the sand.
I'm rushing in now.
I follow the ripples it leaves.
The sand below is shifting.
It's heading for the coral.
I chase along the bottom.
My tail beats faster.
It has stopped.

lines.zh: 它的影子落在我背上了。
lines.en: Its shadow has fallen on my back.
Fins along the sand, I take its flank.
I've stirred up the sand.
I bite down.
I bite its leg.
Sand flies up and blocks the view.
I sweep my tail at it.
It steps back.
I turn and bite again.
I bite a mouthful of mud off its boot.

lines.zh: 我扬起的沙把它的眼遮住。
lines.en: The sand cloud blinds its view.
I drag it down.
It pulls free; I let go.
I return to the sand.
A new shadow in the warm water.
A small patch of sand bulges.
The warm current passes right here.
I shake the sand off.
Coral nearby; good.
I begin swimming along the bottom.
The light on the surface sways.
My scent isn't here yet.

lines.zh: 沙面鼓起，我从底下出来。
lines.en: The sand bulges and I come out from under it.
I find a spot to settle.

lines.zh: 火在水下也烫，我的沙壳裂了。
lines.en: Fire burns even here; my sand crust cracks.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔到沙上，弹了两下。
lines.en: I hit the sand from a height and bounce twice.

lines.zh: 水一下太多，我方向都乱了。
lines.en: Too much water at once; I lose direction.

lines.zh: 炸响把沙全掀起来，我也被卷了。
lines.en: The blast throws the sand up, and me with it.
A barb lodges under my scales.

lines.zh: 有股力量把我从沙里拽出来。
lines.en: Something pulls me out of the sand.
Hunger slows my swimming.
Lightning enters the water; I go numb.
Not even sand to hide in.
